lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gills. Each column contains four to five visible blobs, forming a 2D grid-like arrangement with approximately equal spacing between centroids along the vertical and horizontal axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of blobs; these blobs act as high-intensity anchor nodes at the intersection points of the vertical stripes and the underlying horizontal patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with a light-intensity highlight on the upper edge and a distinct shadow-cast gradient on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots, particularly concentrated along the leading edge and distal surface, which contrasts with the larger, sparser blob constellation on the lateral body.
